title: Greek Zoodle Salad
description: Replace spaghetti noodles with "zoodles", noodles made from zucchini, in this Greek salad with olive, tomato, and feta cheese.
ingredients: 10 cherry tomatoes, halved, or more to taste
10 pitted kalamata olives, halved, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Cut zucchini into noodle-shaped strands using a spiralizing tool. Place "zoodles" in a large bowl and top with cucumber, tomatoes, olives, red onion, and feta cheese.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper together in a bowl until dressing is smooth; pour over "zoodle" mixture and toss to coat. Marinate salad in refrigerator for 10 to 15 minutes.

video.description: Pack even more nutrition into your Greek salad by switching out the pasta for zoodles, the spiralized zucchini that’s taking meal time by storm! Mix zoodles from 2 zucchinis with chopped English cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, pitted Kalamata olives and thinly sliced red onion. Toss with crumbled feta cheese, then bring everything together with olive oil, lemon juice, oregano and salt and pepper. Marinate for maximum flavor and serve up fresh for flavor full of zip and zestiness!
